data_facts_with_vis_data.paragraph: Statista suggests that five of the top ten leading pharmaceutical companies were based in the US as of 2021, including Pfizer, AbbVie, Johnson & Johnson, Bristol Myers Squibb, and Merck & Co. AbbVie alone generated $55 billion in 2021.

The US pharmaceutical industry dominates the global pharmaceutical market, accounting for roughly 50% of the global pharmaceutical sales revenue. According to an article published by Zippia, the US pharmaceutical industry generated $550 billion in revenue in 2021, accounting for 48% of the global pharmaceutical market as of 2020.

facts.fact_content: The US pharmaceutical industry accounts for roughly 50% of the global pharmaceutical sales revenue.
The US pharmaceutical industry generated $550 billion in revenue in 2021.
The US pharmaceutical industry accounted for 48% of the global pharmaceutical market as of 2020.

data_facts_with_vis_data.paragraph: The ABPI notes that the annual turnover of the pharmaceutical industry in the UK is roughly $50.21 billion. According to Statista, the UK pharmaceutical market accounts for 2.6% of the global pharmaceutical market, with nearly 7000 manufacturers and developers as of 2020. AstraZeneca and GlaxoSmithKline are the two largest drug manufacturing companies in the United Kingdom.

facts.fact_content: The annual turnover of the pharmaceutical industry in the UK is roughly $50.21 billion.
The UK pharmaceutical market accounts for 2.6% of the global pharmaceutical market.

data_facts_with_vis_data.paragraph: Digestive and metabolic drugs and systemic anti-infective drugs account for 14% of the Chinese pharmaceutical market. Cardiovascular and central nervous system drugs each account for slightly less at 13% each. In the Chinese pharmaceutical market, patent and generic drugs account for relatively similar market shares at 56% and 44%, respectively.

facts.fact_content: Digestive and metabolic drugs and systemic anti-infective drugs account for 14% of the Chinese pharmaceutical market.
Cardiovascular and central nervous system drugs each account for 13% of the Chinese pharmaceutical market.
Patent and generic drugs account for 56% and 44% of the Chinese pharmaceutical market, respectively.

data_facts_with_vis_data.paragraph: According to an article published in China Briefing, the Chinese biopharmaceutical market has grown drastically in the past few years, with a 200% increase in market capitalization between 2016 and 2020. As of 2019, the Chinese healthcare industry was valued at $900 billion and is expected to grow to $2.3 trillion by 2030. As part of the healthcare market, the biopharmaceutical market was valued at $47.6 billion in 2020 and is expected to grow to $111.76 billion by 2025. Even with the drastic growth in the past few years, the Chinese pharmaceutical market is only a fraction of the US pharmaceutical market.

facts.fact_content: The Chinese biopharmaceutical market increased by 200% in market capitalization between 2016 and 2020.
The Chinese healthcare industry was valued at $900 billion as of 2019.
The Chinese healthcare industry is expected to grow to $2.3 trillion by 2030.
The Chinese biopharmaceutical market was valued at $47.6 billion in 2020.
The Chinese biopharmaceutical market is expected to grow to $111.76 billion by 2025.

data_facts_with_vis_data.paragraph: According to a consumer market insights report by Statista, China generates the most over-the-counter revenue, accounting for $29.36 million of the $145.3 billion in global revenue.

facts.fact_content: China generates $29.36 million in over-the-counter revenue.
